newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Garment firm Beijing Tango to launch A share offer.
newsitem.headline: Garment firm Beijing Tango to launch A share offer.

text.p: China's Beijing Zhongyan Tango Eider-down Products Co Ltd will launch an initial public offer of 33.60 million A shares via the Shanghai bourse's automated quotation system later this month, a company spokesman said on Friday.

The spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin that the offer, tentatively priced at 4.10 yuan per share, has received permission from the China Securities Regulatory Commission.
China Southern Securities has been appointed the lead underwriter for the offer and the shares will be listed in Shanghai, the official said.
Garment-maker Tango currently has total share capital of 100 million legal person, or institution, shares, the official said.

He said Tango plans to use the proceeds from the offer to expand its business. Tango has forecast net earnings of 50.77 million yuan for this year, compared with about 17 million yuan in 1995, the official added.
